c0921: Key elements of the pre-shift meeting:

c0937: Communicate each table's restrictions to the dining room team
c0939: Identify the day's VIPs (name, table, preferences)
c0941: Chef's table today: confirm menu, timing, storytelling

c0944: Day's pairing confirmed by the sommelier
c0945: Pairing changes from the previous day

c0955: ▸ Plan the whole year with seasonal menu changes.
c0956: ▸ Identify key dates for special menus.
c0958: ▸ Prepare ahead with enough lead time.
c0969: Winter menu established. Black truffle (peak season). Farm-raised game, if your supplier has it. New Year's Day menu (Jan 1). Annual event planning.
c0973: Valentine's Day (Feb 14): special tasting menu for couples. Black truffle (final phase). Seasonal citrus. Prep for the spring menu change.
c0977: SPRING MENU CHANGE. Asparagus, peas, fava beans. R&D sessions for new spring dishes. St. Patrick's Day (Mar 17) only if it suits your house. Local food festival (check).
c0980: Spring menu up and running. Easter and Passover (dates vary): high covers, special menu. Spring celebration season starts (graduations in May–June): midday groups, set menu and deposit. Artichokes, edible flowers. Prepare the seasonal pop-up.
c0983: Graduations in full swing + Mother's Day (2nd Sunday): two of the fullest midday services of the year. Memorial Day (last Monday). Cherries, strawberries, loquats. Green asparagus. Bluefin tuna (start of season). Prep for the summer menu change.
c0986: SUMMER MENU CHANGE. Last graduations and weddings of the season. Seasonal tomatoes, peach, apricot. Signature gazpachos and cold soups. Father's Day (3rd Sunday). Patio / outdoor dinners.
c0989: Summer menu established. Independence Day (Jul 4): decide your hours. Figs, melon, watermelon. Pairing with crisp wines and rosés. Culinary tourism: high covers.
c0992: Peak summer occupancy. No federal holiday in August: stagger team vacations and set the schedules weeks in advance. Peppers, eggplant, zucchini. Signature ice creams (extra production). Prep for the fall menu change.
c0995: FALL MENU CHANGE. Wild mushrooms (start of season). Grapes, late figs. Harvest pairing dinners with wineries. Labor Day (1st Monday).
c0998: Full mushroom season (porcini, chanterelle, black trumpet). Pumpkin, sweet potato. Chestnuts. Local fall food festival. Halloween (Oct 31) if it fits.
c1001: Thanksgiving (4th Thursday): decide whether to open or run a prix fixe menu. Black truffle (start of season). Game. Prep holiday menus. December reservations open.
c1004: WINTER MENU CHANGE. Holiday parties (corporate dinners), Christmas Eve and Christmas Day (many close on the 25th), New Year's Eve (gala menu, champagne toast for guests 21+). Truffle, foie gras, shellfish, caviar. Peak revenue of the year.
